as_told.title: Younger Dryas comet airburst wiped out a proto-civilization

plain: The claim is that about 12,800 years ago Earth ran through the debris trail of a breaking-up comet, an idea known as the Younger Dryas impact hypothesis. The writer Graham Hancock, who argues for lost ancient civilizations, describes it on the show and credits the Comet Research Group, a group of researchers who study the idea. Michels, in another episode, places the debris in the Taurid meteor stream, calls it an airburst near the end of the last ice age, and adds that it may have wiped out an early civilization, crediting Hancock, a researcher named Randall Carlson, and Plato.
